_comment: Showcase generations pre-computed by `python -m worldmodels.cli warm-cache` on the GPU pod before the customer meeting. Replay mode serves them by id (worldmodels.showcase) and as nearest-prompt matches for live-typed what-if questions. condition: none = text2video, image = first frame of source_clip (image2video), video = continue source_clip (video2video). source_clip: auto = first kept curated clip, auto:<defect> = first kept clip with that defect. The what-if ids/prompts mirror copilot/models.py CHANGE_TEMPLATES so live copilot requests replay as exact-prompt (or nearest-prompt) cache hits.

what_if.title: Baseline: FCAW fill pass inside the WPS window
what_if.prompt: Steady FCAW fill pass with stable arc, consistent ripple spacing and a smooth, flat bead that wets evenly into both bevel faces

what_if.title: What if travel speed drops 20%?
what_if.prompt: Robot travel speed is reduced by 20 percent. Heat input rises about 25 percent: the molten pool grows larger and hotter, the bead becomes wider and flatter with coarser ripples, and the glow trail behind the arc lengthens.

what_if.title: What if shielding gas flow collapses?
what_if.prompt: Shielding gas flow collapses from 21 to 5 litres per minute. The arc becomes erratic and flickers, spatter increases, the pool surface oxidises and gas pores appear in the trailing bead.

what_if.title: Porosity synthesis for detector training
what_if.prompt: Clusters of spherical gas pores (porosity) form in the solidifying weld bead behind the arc, with visible surface-breaking blowholes.

what_if.title: What if arc voltage runs 20% high?
what_if.prompt: Arc voltage increases by 20 percent: the arc lengthens and widens, and an undercut groove is melted into both toes of the bead without being filled.

what_if.title: What if interpass temperature exceeds the WPS maximum?
what_if.prompt: Interpass temperature exceeds the procedure maximum; a fine longitudinal centreline crack opens in the cooling bead.

what_if.title: What if the GTAW root runs hot and slow?
what_if.prompt: GTAW root pass with current 30 percent high and travel slowing down: the keyhole grows, the root melts through and molten metal sags out of the joint as burn-through

what_if.title: Continue the inspected clip for 5 more seconds
what_if.prompt: The robot continues the same weld pass with the same parameters, the positioner keeps rotating the pipe and the bead keeps growing along the joint

transfer.title: Sim -> real from the simulator edge map
transfer.prompt: Photoreal torch-camera footage of a robotic FCAW fill pass on carbon-steel pipe, bright arc, glowing weld pool and grey solidified bead with fine ripples

transfer.title: Sim -> real from the simulator depth map
transfer.prompt: Photoreal torch-camera footage of a robotic FCAW fill pass on carbon-steel pipe, bright arc, glowing weld pool and grey solidified bead with fine ripples

transfer.title: Sim -> real, edge + depth, porosity pass
transfer.prompt: Photoreal torch-camera footage of a robotic FCAW pass where gas pockets erupt through the weld pool and leave surface porosity in the bead
